quota_gates.description: Hard gates prevent HAL spawn if quotas are dangerously high

quota_austerity.description: When quota > 70%, use only LOCAL/Codex to preserve remaining budget

monitoring.description: Daily monitoring of quota burn rate and context growth

recovery.description: Automated recovery actions if thresholds breached

tuning_notes.alfred_context_limit_pct_notes: Conservative: 75% leaves 5% headroom before gate 2. If too aggressive, lower to 70%. If too lenient, raise to 80% (not recommended).
tuning_notes.subscription_quota_limit_pct_notes: 85% leaves 15% buffer for Alfred's essential work. Don't lower below 80%.
tuning_notes.quota_austerity_enabled_at_pct_notes: At 70% quota consumed, HAL model selection becomes conservative. Adjust +/- 5% if quota burn too fast/slow.
tuning_notes.codex_timeout_threshold_notes: 2 timeouts = Codex is saturated. Increase to 3 if false-positive rate high; decrease to 1 if needed aggressively.
